title: Enterprise SAML / Okta SSO Integration
description: Implement SAML 2.0 and Okta OpenID Connect authentication to satisfy enterprise compliance requirements.
executiveSummary: Unblocks $280k ARR renewal for Acme Global by fulfilling enterprise security requirements. Introduces standard SAML auth flow.

title: Edge Cache API Layer for Product Catalogs
description: Integrate Cloudflare Cache API (caches.default) to cache high-traffic public catalog queries at the edge.
executiveSummary: Reduces Worker CPU time by 65% and drops P95 latency by 145ms by serving cached responses directly from Cloudflare edge caches.

title: Patch CVE-2026-8812 (Algorithm Confusion in Token Parser)
description: Enforce strict algorithm pinning (RS256 only) in JWT token verification to prevent HMAC algorithm confusion attacks.
executiveSummary: Eliminates critical remote authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-8812). Pins crypto algorithms to RS256.

title: Stripe Multi-Currency Billing (EUR & GBP Support)
description: Support multi-currency subscription checkouts in EUR and GBP to unlock European enterprise sales pipeline.
executiveSummary: Expands billing pipeline across EMEA, unlocking an estimated $190k in new annual recurring revenue.

title: D1 Database Query Batching & Prepared Statements
description: Combine sequential D1 SQL operations into batched db.batch() calls to eliminate roundtrip latency and query charges.
executiveSummary: Reduces D1 database roundtrips from 4 calls to 1 batched execution per request, lowering D1 operation costs by 45%.

title: Distributed Rate Limiting on Auth Endpoints
description: Add Cloudflare Workers Rate Limiting binding to /api/auth to mitigate credential stuffing and brute-force attacks.
executiveSummary: Prevents brute force attacks by capping authentication attempts to 5 per minute per IP using Cloudflare Rate Limiting.

title: SOC2 Real-time Audit Logging Stream
description: Stream audit log events for all administrative and user data actions to Cloudflare K2 for SOC2 compliance.
executiveSummary: Mandatory compliance feature required to sign Vanguard Capital ($350k ARR deal). Emits immutable audit trails.

title: Zstandard & Brotli Payload Compression
description: Compress large JSON responses dynamically at the edge to reduce egress bandwidth and speed up mobile clients.
executiveSummary: Saves 35% on global egress bandwidth and accelerates response delivery for mobile and high-latency clients.

title: Runtime Input Validation & SQL Injection Armor
description: Enforce strict schema validation and parameter binding on all tenant-facing API endpoints.
executiveSummary: Closes security vulnerability in search filters by strictly enforcing parameterized type coercion.

title: Streaming CSV & Parquet Data Export
description: Enable asynchronous streaming export of analytics datasets directly into downloadable files.
executiveSummary: Fulfills the #1 most requested feature on the public roadmap, unblocking expansion in the mid-market tier.
